services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      MONGO_URI: mongodb://mongo:27017
      MONGO_DB: app_db
      RABBITMQ_URL: amqp://guest:guest@rabbitmq:5672/
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - app-network

  mongo:
    image: mongo:7
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - mongo_data:/data/db
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "--eval", "db.adminCommand('ping')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - app-network

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    volumes:
      - rabbitmq_data:/var/lib/rabbitmq
